name: @sauce/remote
description: SauceScript remote messages: a program on one chain runs code on the same Private Pot on another, over Hyperlane, Metalayer, LayerZero V2 or Polymer, and with a `.then` gets what it returned back. The class composes both legs while compiling, on @sauce/async's Request; the handlers a Pot installs per bridge (`handlers`, one per selector, each only on a chain with its bridge's contract) check the bridge's contract and that the sender is the same Pot. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (remote.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the bridges and the handler a Pot's Router runs are EVM contracts.
